units.source_text: 身体发麻了，但心灵还是在什么地方摆弄着记忆中的事。

en.t: My body had gone numb, but somewhere my mind was still toying with things from memory.

units.source_text: 某些语言偶尔泛起又消失了。

en.t: Certain words would occasionally rise up and then disappear again.

units.source_text: 心灵的手即将够着又隐通了……

en.t: The hand of my mind was about to reach them, and then they slipped away into the hidden distance...
Those words were calling out to me.

units.source_text: 也许是为了鼓舞我，才接近我的吧。

en.t: Perhaps they had drawn near to me in order to encourage me.
